name: Exterior Engineered Wood Siding RP Surface Preparation
intent: RP prep — low-pressure wash, scrape/feather (condition-driven), degloss/scuff, caulk repair, moisture check, dust cleanup. No end-seal (construction task).
doctrine: RP prep for engineered wood siding. Low-pressure wash (500-1000 PSI, fan tip). Condition modifier on scrape/feather (GOOD:1.0, FAIR:1.5, POOR:2.0). No end-seal (construction task). Caulk siding-to-trim only (NOT butt joints — moisture trap on OSB core). Moisture check critical — MC > 15% = stop work. Profile and texture modifiers apply to scrape and degloss.
